Recent notes

  • LNL target designs compared 2026-10-27LnlTarget

    Seven MX17 target designs for LNL side by side: drawings, Geant4 days per µA, opening-angle resolution and the material on each lepton; one slide per design.

  • LNL target designs in Geant4 2026-10-27

    Pierfrancesco’s Cu hemisphere and the flat diamond window, simulated with the MX17 arms as built and with the big plastics, at 1.03 and 1.10 MeV: reach, backgrounds, contamination, trigger and DREAM, scintillator load.

  • MX17 chamber bow 2026-10-27Mx17Model audit

    The readout boards of all five MX17 chambers are bowed by 1.5-2.3 mm (centre lower): three independent routes, sign from external facts, consistency across runs, a plate-model plausibility check and a held-out gate of the correction.

  • MX17 chamber maps 2026-10-27Mx17Model audit

    Gallery of every per-chamber map (bow, drift tilt, angle scale, v(t), column, gain, connector gains, efficiency, dead strips, noise bands) of the five June bench chambers, each marked whether the reconstruction uses it.

  • MX17 model audit: results 2026-10-27MicromegasReconstructionSPS

    The bench angle problems were mostly calibration (t0, tilt, bow, a selection cut), not the physics model; SPS fixes the footprint; physics floor 0.3°; one reconstruction.

  • MX17 efficiency: where every track goes 2026-10-26Cosmic benchMicromegasEfficiency

    Every M3 track crossing a bench chamber followed to where it ends: det3 interior 91.2 % detected, 93.3 % found, 95.2 % of non-spark crossings; the rest is sparks, second particles, delta rays and the fit. All five chambers, interior and edge, 5 and 3 mm.
